title: Cerro’s lessons against wards
summary: What Bell learned for beating sorcery.

claims.text: Don Cerro kept quiet ties with several thaumaturges and learned some key ways of defeating sorcerous defences, which Cerro passed on to Theo Bell.

title: Angus Abranson
summary: A Minneapolis elder and old friend of Theo Bell.

claims.text: The novel The Overseer tells that Angus Abranson holds a seat on the Minneapolis primogen and has been a friend of Theo Bell since the two met in London about a hundred years ago.
